states.compatibility: Types differ but share messages reducer. Adapter sufficient for initial integration: retain outer conversation state, keep normative inputs/result/provenance in a bounded tool contract, do not merge states. Neither prior text nor raw ToolMessage is authoritative normative evidence.

bypass_points.description: No tool-call enforcement: model may emit new normative claim and END without retrieval; prompts alone constrain behavior.
Raw text evidence passes tool -> LLM -> user without current DomainRouter, TemporalIntent, VersionFilter, TemporalGroundingContext or StructuredOutputV2.
Hardcoded RGG factual hierarchy includes percentages, credit conversion and revocation statement; not scoped validated evidence. Multi-search minimum is prompt-only.
LLM sees full prior messages and raw tool text; no typed grounded-followup boundary prevents previous answer from becoming authority.
Alternative graphs retrieve unrestricted evidence and generate outside current normative invariants. Keep unavailable for new normative claims.

future_tool_loop_compatibility.adapter_needed: Existing Calculator or separately reviewed deterministic tool can be bound beside a future normative_rag tool; require typed action/authority policy and bounded loop.
blockers: Default legacy Supabase paths must not remain an alternate normative source.
No proven typed follow-up provenance/authority policy.
future_tool_loop_compatibility.recommendation: Prefer one normative_rag boundary wrapping selected current core, with vector and structural metadata strategies internal, before considering full nested subgraph embedding.
